description: Use this when the user wants a small fragrance wardrobe or collection (three to five perfumes for different moments) built around perfumes or notes they already love, or asks what to add next (synonyms: signature scents, collection, rotation, what else should I own). Returns roles such as daytime, evening and warm weather, each with a perfume, its house, why it fits and a scento.com link in the user's language. Don't use for a single occasion (occasion-edit) or the neighbours of one perfume (scent-neighbours).

avoid.description: Perfumes, notes or families to leave out, up to six. Examples: ["oud"] or ["Sauvage", "Velvet Sweet"].

lang.description: Language of the scento.com links and labels; answers stay in English. Use the language the user writes in, for example "de" (German), "fr" (French), "es" (Spanish) or "it" (Italian). Default "en".

loves.description: Perfumes or notes the person already loves, one to six. Examples: ["Aventus", "iris"] or ["Santal 33"].

size.description: How many perfumes the wardrobe holds, 3 to 5. Example: 4. Default 3.

name: wardrobe-composer
title: Build a fragrance wardrobe
